The Telegram Mini App native header is not part of the design system. All layouts start below the Telegram-provided header. Spacing has been calculated based on the real Telegram environment on Android and iOS.
Telegram Header Content Bottom Sheet (Resized) Keyboard

Mini App States document the primary interface scenarios within the Telegram Mini App to ensure consistent behavior across different devices, operating systems, and system interactions. These states define how the layout should adapt when the system keyboard appears, bottom sheets are displayed, or the available viewport changes. During keyboard interactions, the interface should automatically adjust by keeping the focused input visible, allowing content to scroll, hiding temporary UI elements such as the bottom navigation, removing the bottom safe area, and ensuring that interactive components remain accessible without being obscured. This documentation serves as the reference for implementing responsive layout behavior and maintaining a consistent user experience throughout the application.

The native bottom safe area is not included in the design. During development, please use the platform’s Safe Area APIs / CSS safe-area insets to dynamically apply the required bottom spacing across supported Telegram devices.
